```{r setup, include = FALSE}
# =============================================================================
# 07_interim_summary.Rmd
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# A short summary to share with collaborators. It answers two questions:
#   1. Do the five experimental blocks differ on block-level self-report, Ledalab SCR,
#      ECG HR/HRV, FaceReader HR/HRV and FaceReader action units?
#   2. Do FaceReader and ECG agree on HR and HRV (both run through Kubios)?
#
# It only READS outputs that other scripts already make. Run these first:
#   01_data_cleaning.Rmd             -> clean_combined_data/psychopy/biosignals2_selfreport_ratings.csv
#   05_analyse_ledalab_scr.Rmd       -> clean_combined_data/biosignals2_eda.csv
#                                       (otherwise read straight from ledalab/*_era.txt)
#   Kubios on the ECG                -> kubios/<id>_*_hrv.csv or KubiosHRVresults*.csv
#   kubios/002_create_kubios_samples_video.py, then Kubios on <id>_facereader_beats_kubios.txt
#                                    -> facereader/Kubios_Samples.csv + the FaceReader Kubios report
#   FaceReader detailed log export   -> facereader/<id>_detailed.txt (or .xlsx)
# Any source that isn't there yet is skipped with a note; nothing stops the knit.
#
# Knit: Rscript -e "rmarkdown::render('analysis/07_interim_summary.Rmd')"
# The HTML is self-contained (one file). It prints no file paths, and participant IDs are
# replaced by P01, P02, ... when ANONYMISE_IDS is TRUE.
# =============================================================================
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 9, fig.height = 4.2, dpi = 110)

# ── Settings ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
INCLUDE_PILOTS     <- FALSE  # TRUE = also analyse pilot participants (participant_status.csv)
ANONYMISE_IDS      <- TRUE   # P01, P02, ... instead of real IDs in the tables
MIN_FACE_VALID     <- 0.50   # FaceReader AUs: drop a block with less than this share of frames with a face
MIN_BLOCK_BEATS    <- 100    # Kubios FaceReader: drop a block with fewer beats (~150-250 expected in 3 min)
MAX_IBI_GAP_S      <- 2      # FaceReader coverage: beats further apart than this = no heart-rate signal in between
FLAG_CORRECTED_PCT <- 5      # Kubios: blocks with more than this % of beats corrected are counted as noisy
KUBIOS_CORRECTION  <- "Medium"  # Kubios artefact (noise) correction level used for ECG and FaceReader - reported in the HTML
KEY_AUS            <- c("AU04", "AU06", "AU09", "AU12")   # AUs plotted individually

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(stringr); library(readr); library(purrr)
  library(ggplot2); library(knitr); library(lmerTest); library(emmeans)
})
emm_options(lmer.df = "satterthwaite", msg.interaction = FALSE)

# ── config.R (repo root) and participant_status ──────────────────────────────
find_up <- function(start, file) {
  d <- normalizePath(start, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
  repeat {
    if (file.exists(file.path(d, file))) return(d)
    p <- dirname(d); if (p == d) return(NA_character_); d <- p
  }
}
start_dir <- tryCatch(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
start_dir <- if (is.null(start_dir) || is.na(start_dir)) getwd() else dirname(start_dir)
repo_dir  <- find_up(start_dir, "config.R")
if (is.na(repo_dir)) stop("config.R not found above ", start_dir, ". Copy config_template.R to config.R.")
source(file.path(repo_dir, "config.R"))
analysis_dir <- file.path(repo_dir, "analysis")
PARTICIPANT_STATUS_PATH <- file.path(analysis_dir, "participant_status.csv")
source(file.path(analysis_dir, "participant_status.R"), local = TRUE)

FR_DIR     <- get0("FACEREADER_RESULTS_DIR", ifnotfound = file.path(SERVER_ROOT, "facereader"))
KUBIOS_DIR <- get0("KUBIOS_RESULTS_DIR",     ifnotfound = file.path(SERVER_ROOT, "kubios"))
```

```{r helpers}
# ── Blocks ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
BLOCKS       <- c("baseline", "neg_induction", "neg_recovery", "pos_induction", "pos_recovery")
BLOCK_LABELS <- c("Baseline", "Neg induction", "Neg recovery", "Pos induction", "Pos recovery")
BLOCK_COLS   <- setNames(c("#888888", "#D9653B", "#F0B49A", "#3F7FB5", "#A8C4D8"), BLOCK_LABELS)

# Any block spelling used in this project -> one of BLOCKS. Recovery is tested first because
# "post_negative_induction_recovery" contains both words.
to_block <- function(x) {
  x <- tolower(str_replace_all(str_remove(str_trim(as.character(x)), "\\(\\d+\\)$"), "[ -]+", "_"))
  neg <- str_detect(x, "^neg|_neg|negative"); pos <- str_detect(x, "^pos|_pos|positive")
  rec <- str_detect(x, "recov|reconv");      ind <- str_detect(x, "induc")
  case_when(str_detect(x, "baseline") ~ "baseline",
            neg & rec ~ "neg_recovery",  pos & rec ~ "pos_recovery",
            neg & ind ~ "neg_induction", pos & ind ~ "pos_induction",
            TRUE ~ NA_character_)
}
block_factor <- function(b) factor(BLOCK_LABELS[match(b, BLOCKS)], levels = BLOCK_LABELS)

norm_pid <- function(x) toupper(str_trim(as.character(x)))
keep_pids <- function(d) d |> filter(participant_keep(pid, INCLUDE_PILOTS))
num <- function(x) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(str_replace(str_trim(as.character(x)), ",", ".")))
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a)) b else a

# Every loader returns a long tibble: pid, block (factor), measure, value.
# A loader that can't find its data returns an empty tibble with attr "note".
empty_long <- function(note) structure(tibble(pid = character(), block = factor(levels = BLOCK_LABELS),
                                              measure = character(), value = numeric()), note = note)
safely_load <- function(expr, what) tryCatch(expr, error = function(e)
  empty_long(paste0(what, ": could not be read (", conditionMessage(e), ")")))
show_note <- function(d) if (!is.null(attr(d, "note"))) cat("> **Not shown:** ", attr(d, "note"), "\n\n", sep = "")

# ── Statistics ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Linear mixed model per measure: value ~ block + (1 | participant). Reports the omnibus block
# effect (Satterthwaite F test) and three planned contrasts. Blocks a measure doesn't have are
# simply left out of its model.
CONTRASTS <- list(`Neg ind - Baseline` = c(`Neg induction` = 1, Baseline = -1),
                  `Pos ind - Baseline` = c(`Pos induction` = 1, Baseline = -1),
                  `Pos ind - Neg ind`  = c(`Pos induction` = 1, `Neg induction` = -1))

block_test <- function(d) {
  d <- d |> filter(!is.na(value)) |> mutate(block = droplevels(block))
  out <- tibble(n = n_distinct(d$pid), F = NA_real_, df = NA_character_, p = NA_real_)
  for (k in names(CONTRASTS)) out[[k]] <- NA_real_
  for (k in names(CONTRASTS)) out[[paste0(k, " p")]] <- NA_real_
  if (out$n < 3 || nlevels(d$block) < 2) return(out)
  m <- tryCatch(suppressMessages(lmer(value ~ block + (1 | pid), data = d)), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(m)) return(out)
  a <- anova(m)
  out$F <- a$`F value`[1]; out$df <- sprintf("%d, %.1f", a$NumDF[1], a$DenDF[1]); out$p <- a$`Pr(>F)`[1]
  emm <- emmeans(m, ~ block)
  lv  <- levels(d$block)
  for (k in names(CONTRASTS)) {
    w <- CONTRASTS[[k]]
    if (!all(names(w) %in% lv)) next
    v <- setNames(rep(0, length(lv)), lv); v[names(w)] <- w
    s <- summary(contrast(emm, method = setNames(list(unname(v)), k)))
    out[[k]] <- s$estimate; out[[paste0(k, " p")]] <- s$p.value
  }
  out
}

block_means <- function(d) d |>
  group_by(measure, block) |>
  summarise(m = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), s = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(txt = ifelse(is.na(s), sprintf("%.2f", m), sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", m, s))) |>
  select(measure, block, txt) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = block, values_from = txt)

test_table <- function(d, fdr = FALSE) {
  if (!nrow(d)) return(tibble())
  t <- d |> group_by(measure) |> group_modify(~ block_test(.x)) |> ungroup()
  if (fdr) t$`p (FDR)` <- p.adjust(t$p, "BH")
  t
}

fmt_p   <- function(p) ifelse(is.na(p), "–", ifelse(p < .001, "<.001", sprintf("%.3f", p)))
fmt_est <- function(e, p) ifelse(is.na(e), "–", sprintf("%+.2f%s", e,
                                 ifelse(p < .05, " *", "")))
pretty_tests <- function(t) {
  if (!nrow(t)) return(t)
  out <- t |> transmute(Measure = measure, N = n,
                        `Block effect` = ifelse(is.na(F), "–", sprintf("F(%s) = %.2f", df, F)),
                        p = fmt_p(p))
  if ("p (FDR)" %in% names(t)) out$`p (FDR)` <- fmt_p(t$`p (FDR)`)
  for (k in names(CONTRASTS)) out[[k]] <- fmt_est(t[[k]], t[[paste0(k, " p")]])
  out
}

# ── Plot: one panel per measure, thin line per participant, mean ± SE ────────
plot_blocks <- function(d, ncol = 3, ylab = NULL) {
  s <- d |> group_by(measure, block) |>
    summarise(m = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), se = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(value))),
              .groups = "drop")
  ggplot(d, aes(block, value)) +
    geom_line(aes(group = pid), colour = "grey80", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_point(colour = "grey70", size = 1) +
    geom_errorbar(data = s, aes(y = m, ymin = m - se, ymax = m + se), width = 0.15, colour = "grey20") +
    geom_point(data = s, aes(y = m, fill = block), shape = 21, size = 3.2, colour = "grey20") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = BLOCK_COLS, guide = "none") +
    facet_wrap(~ measure, scales = "free_y", ncol = ncol) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = ylab) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
}
```

```{r load-ratings}
order_counts <- NULL   # how many participants did the negative / positive block first
# Block-level state ratings (1–7), given at the END of each block (baseline: after the
# 3-min fixation). Not the per-video ratings.
ratings <- safely_load({
  f <- file.path(get0("COMBINED_PSYCHO_DIR", ifnotfound = file.path(SERVER_ROOT, "clean_combined_data", "psychopy")),
                 "biosignals2_selfreport_ratings.csv")
  if (!file.exists(f)) empty_long("biosignals2_selfreport_ratings.csv not found (knit 01_data_cleaning.Rmd).") else
    read_csv(f, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
      (\(d) { order_counts <<- if ("conditionOrder" %in% names(d)) d |> filter(participant_keep(participant_id, INCLUDE_PILOTS)) |>
                 distinct(participant_id, conditionOrder) |> count(conditionOrder) else NULL; d })() |>
      transmute(pid = norm_pid(participant_id), block = to_block(condition),
                Valence = block_end_valence, Arousal = block_end_arousal) |>
      filter(!is.na(block)) |>
      group_by(pid, block) |> summarise(across(c(Valence, Arousal), ~ first(na.omit(.x))), .groups = "drop") |>
      pivot_longer(c(Valence, Arousal), names_to = "measure", values_to = "value") |>
      mutate(block = block_factor(block)) |> keep_pids()
}, "Self-report")
```

```{r load-scr}
# Ledalab continuous decomposition (CDA), one value per block (0–180 s window).
# CDA.SCR = mean phasic driver (primary), CDA.nSCR = number of SCRs, CDA.Tonic = mean tonic level.
SCR_MEASURES <- c(`SCR: mean phasic driver (µS)` = "CDA.SCR",
                  `SCR: count (n)`              = "CDA.nSCR",
                  `SCR: tonic level (µS)`       = "CDA.Tonic")
scr <- safely_load({
  f <- file.path(COMBINED_DATA_DIR, "biosignals2_eda.csv")
  raw <- if (file.exists(f)) {
    read_csv(f, show_col_types = FALSE) |> mutate(block = to_block(condition))
  } else {
    # Fallback, same as 05: ERA files + the NID -> condition map
    era <- list.files(LEDALAB_RESULTS_DIR, pattern = "_era\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)
    map_path <- file.path(BLOCK_ONSETS_DIR, "nid_map_psychopy_ledalab.txt")
    if (!length(era) || !file.exists(map_path)) stop("no biosignals2_eda.csv and no Ledalab ERA files")
    nid <- read_tsv(map_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
    map_dfr(era, function(x) {
      e <- read_tsv(x, show_col_types = FALSE)
      names(e)[tolower(names(e)) == "event.nid"] <- "nid"
      e |> mutate(pid = str_extract(basename(x), "^[^_]+")) |> left_join(nid, by = "nid")
    }) |> mutate(block = to_block(condition))
  }
  raw |> mutate(pid = norm_pid(pid)) |> filter(!is.na(block)) |>
    select(pid, block, any_of(unname(SCR_MEASURES))) |>
    pivot_longer(-c(pid, block), names_to = "measure", values_to = "value") |>
    group_by(pid, block, measure) |> summarise(value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(measure = names(SCR_MEASURES)[match(measure, SCR_MEASURES)], block = block_factor(block),
           value = ifelse(is.nan(value), NA, value)) |>
    keep_pids()
}, "Ledalab SCR")
```

```{r load-kubios}
# Kubios readers (same logic as generate_qc_report.R). The stream (ECG vs FaceReader) is told
# apart by the name of the file Kubios analysed. Per participant and stream the newest
# report is used; the batch summary (KubiosHRVresults*.csv, samples S1..S5 in
# Kubios_Samples.csv order) only when there is no report.
kubios_stream <- function(name) {
  n <- tolower(basename(as.character(name)))
  case_when(str_detect(n, "facereader|heart beat log") ~ "facereader",
            str_detect(n, "webcam") ~ "webcam", TRUE ~ "ecg")
}
kub_blank <- function(x) x[!is.na(x) & nzchar(x)]

read_kubios_report <- function(f) {
  L <- tryCatch(read_lines(f), error = function(e) character(0))
  h <- which(str_detect(L, fixed("RR Interval Samples Selected for Analysis")))[1]
  if (is.na(h)) return(tibble())
  labels <- kub_blank(str_trim(str_split(L[h + 1], ",")[[1]][-1]))
  n <- length(labels); if (!n) return(tibble())
  val <- function(pattern) {
    i <- which(str_detect(L, pattern))[1]
    x <- if (is.na(i)) rep(NA_real_, n) else num(kub_blank(str_trim(str_split(L[i], ",")[[1]][-1])))
    length(x) <- n; x
  }
  tibble(pid = norm_pid(str_extract(basename(f), "^[^_]+")), stream = kubios_stream(f),
         block = to_block(labels), n_beats = val(fixed("Beats total:")),
         HR = val(fixed("Mean HR (beats/min):")), RMSSD = val(fixed("RMSSD (ms):")),
         SDNN = val(fixed("SDNN (ms):")),
         corrected = val(regex("^\\s*(Beats?|Artefacts?|Artifacts?) corrected", ignore_case = TRUE)),
         mtime = file.mtime(f), from = "report")
}
read_kubios_batch <- function(f) {
  raw <- tryCatch(read_csv(f, skip = 2, col_types = cols(.default = col_character()),
                           name_repair = "unique_quiet", show_col_types = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(raw) || !"FileName" %in% names(raw)) return(tibble())
  raw <- raw |> filter(!is.na(FileName), nzchar(str_trim(FileName)))
  col <- function(i, m) { k <- paste0("S", i, "_", m); if (k %in% names(raw)) num(raw[[k]]) else NA_real_ }
  map_dfr(seq_along(BLOCKS), function(i) tibble(
    pid = norm_pid(str_extract(basename(raw$FileName), "^[^_]+")), stream = kubios_stream(raw$FileName),
    block = BLOCKS[i], n_beats = NA_real_, HR = col(i, "Mean HR (bpm)"), RMSSD = col(i, "RMSSD (ms)"),
    SDNN = col(i, "SDNN (ms)"), corrected = col(i, "Beats corrected (%)"), mtime = file.mtime(f), from = "batch"))
}

kubios <- safely_load({
  dirs <- unique(c(KUBIOS_DIR, file.path(KUBIOS_DIR, "kubios"), FR_DIR, file.path(FR_DIR, "kubios")))
  dirs <- dirs[dir.exists(dirs)]
  rep_files   <- unlist(map(dirs, ~ list.files(.x, "_hrv\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)))
  batch_files <- unlist(map(dirs, ~ list.files(.x, "^KubiosHRVresults.*\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)))
  reps  <- map_dfr(unique(rep_files), read_kubios_report)
  batch <- map_dfr(unique(batch_files), read_kubios_batch)
  pick_newest <- function(d) if (!nrow(d)) d else d |> group_by(pid, stream) |> filter(mtime == max(mtime)) |>
    group_by(pid, stream, block) |> slice_tail(n = 1) |> ungroup()
  reps <- pick_newest(reps); batch <- pick_newest(batch)
  k <- bind_rows(reps, if (nrow(batch)) anti_join(batch, distinct(reps, pid, stream), by = c("pid", "stream")))
  if (!nrow(k)) stop("no Kubios reports or batch summaries found")
  k |> filter(stream %in% c("ecg", "facereader"), !is.na(block), !is.na(HR)) |>
    mutate(pid = norm_pid(pid)) |> keep_pids()
}, "Kubios")

# Kubios artefact correction per block (before any block is dropped), for section 1.1
kubios_qc <- if (nrow(kubios)) kubios |> select(pid, stream, block, n_beats, corrected) else
  tibble(pid = character(), stream = character(), block = character(), n_beats = numeric(), corrected = numeric())

# FaceReader blocks with too few beats are unreliable -> dropped everywhere below
fr_low_beats <- if (nrow(kubios)) kubios |> filter(stream == "facereader", !is.na(n_beats), n_beats < MIN_BLOCK_BEATS) else tibble()
if (nrow(kubios)) kubios <- kubios |> anti_join(fr_low_beats, by = c("pid", "stream", "block"))

hr_long <- function(s) {
  if (!nrow(kubios)) return(empty_long(attr(kubios, "note")))
  d <- kubios |> filter(stream == s)
  if (!nrow(d)) return(empty_long(paste0("no Kubios results for the ", ifelse(s == "ecg", "ECG", "FaceReader"), " beats yet.")))
  d |> select(pid, block, HR, RMSSD, SDNN) |>
    pivot_longer(c(HR, RMSSD, SDNN), names_to = "measure", values_to = "value") |>
    mutate(measure = recode(measure, HR = "HR (bpm)", RMSSD = "RMSSD (ms)", SDNN = "SDNN (ms)"),
           block = block_factor(block))
}
ecg_hr <- hr_long("ecg")
fr_hr  <- hr_long("facereader")
```

```{r load-aus}
# FaceReader action units per block, from the detailed log (<id>_detailed.txt/.xlsx).
# Block windows: the FaceReader row of facereader/Kubios_Samples.csv (kubios/002), i.e. the SAME
# windows, on FaceReader's own clock, that Kubios used for FaceReader HR/HRV. The detailed log and
# the heart beat log come from the same FaceReader run, so they share that clock; this is checked
# by comparing the video named in both logs.
# Frames where FaceReader found no face (FIND_FAILED / FIT_FAILED) are left out; a block with less
# than MIN_FACE_VALID of its frames with a face is dropped.
au_letters <- c(NotActive = 0, A = 0.11, B = 0.35, C = 0.62, D = 0.85, E = 0.97)
parse_au <- function(x) { v <- num(x); i <- x %in% names(au_letters); v[i] <- au_letters[x[i]]; v }
fr_time <- function(x) {
  x <- str_replace(as.character(x), ",", "."); p <- str_split_fixed(x, ":", 3)
  v <- num(x)   # plain number: seconds, or an Excel day fraction (< 1)
  ifelse(str_detect(x, ":"), num(p[, 1]) * 3600 + num(p[, 2]) * 60 + num(p[, 3]), ifelse(v < 1, v * 86400, v))
}

# Header row (first cell == header_key) and the metadata rows above it
read_fr_log <- function(path, header_key) {
  if (str_detect(path, regex("\\.xlsx?$", ignore_case = TRUE))) {
    g <- as.data.frame(readxl::read_excel(path, sheet = 1, col_names = FALSE, col_types = "text",
                                          .name_repair = "minimal"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    h <- which(str_trim(g[[1]]) == header_key)[1]; if (is.na(h)) return(NULL)
    meta <- g[seq_len(h - 1), 1:2, drop = FALSE]
    body <- g[-seq_len(h), , drop = FALSE]; names(body) <- str_trim(as.character(unlist(g[h, ])))
  } else {
    L <- sub("^﻿", "", readLines(path, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8"))
    h <- which(str_trim(str_extract(L, "^[^\t]*")) == header_key)[1]; if (is.na(h)) return(NULL)
    meta <- as.data.frame(str_split_fixed(L[seq_len(h - 1)], "\t", 3)[, 1:2, drop = FALSE])
    body <- read.delim(text = L[h:length(L)], sep = "\t", colClasses = "character", check.names = FALSE,
                       quote = "", na.strings = character(0), strip.white = TRUE)
  }
  video <- meta[[2]][str_detect(tolower(str_trim(meta[[1]])), "^file ?name")][1]
  list(body = body, video = tolower(basename(gsub("\\\\", "/", str_trim(video %||% NA_character_)))))
}

read_fr_windows <- function() {
  f <- file.path(FR_DIR, "Kubios_Samples.csv")
  if (!file.exists(f)) return(tibble())
  L <- read_lines(f)[-1]; L <- L[nzchar(str_trim(L))]
  map_dfr(str_split(L, ","), function(p) {
    tr <- matrix(p[-(1:2)][seq_len(3 * floor((length(p) - 2) / 3))], ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)
    tibble(file = p[1], block = to_block(tr[, 1]), start = num(tr[, 2]), end = num(tr[, 3]))
  }) |> mutate(pid = norm_pid(str_extract(basename(file), "^[^_]+")),
               is_log = str_detect(tolower(file), "heart beat log")) |>
    filter(!is.na(block), !is.na(start), !is.na(end))
}

au_notes <- character(0)
aus <- safely_load({
  wins <- read_fr_windows()
  if (!nrow(wins)) stop("no facereader/Kubios_Samples.csv (run kubios/002_create_kubios_samples_video.py)")
  logs <- list.files(FR_DIR, "_detailed\\.(txt|xlsx)$", full.names = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
  logs <- logs[!startsWith(basename(logs), "~$")]
  logs <- logs[participant_keep(str_extract(basename(logs), "^[^_]+"), INCLUDE_PILOTS)]
  logs <- logs[!duplicated(norm_pid(str_extract(basename(logs), "^[^_]+")))]   # .txt before .xlsx
  if (!length(logs)) stop("no FaceReader detailed logs (<id>_detailed.txt/.xlsx)")
  out <- map_dfr(logs, function(path) {
    pid <- norm_pid(str_extract(basename(path), "^[^_]+"))
    w <- wins |> filter(pid == !!pid) |> arrange(desc(is_log))   # heart beat log row first (no time shift)
    w <- w |> filter(file == first(file))
    if (!nrow(w)) { au_notes <<- c(au_notes, paste(pid, "– no block windows in Kubios_Samples.csv")); return(tibble()) }
    lg <- read_fr_log(path, "Video Time")
    if (is.null(lg)) { au_notes <<- c(au_notes, paste(pid, "– detailed log has no 'Video Time' header")); return(tibble()) }
    hb <- list.files(FR_DIR, "heart beat log\\.(txt|xlsx)$", full.names = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
    hb <- hb[norm_pid(str_extract(basename(hb), "^[^_]+")) == pid]
    hb_video <- if (length(hb)) tryCatch(read_fr_log(hb[1], "Time")$video, error = function(e) NA) else NA
    if (!is.na(hb_video) && !is.na(lg$video) && hb_video != lg$video) {
      au_notes <<- c(au_notes, paste0(pid, " – detailed log and heart beat log come from different videos ",
                                      "(re-export both from the same FaceReader run)")); return(tibble())
    }
    b <- lg$body
    au_cols <- names(b)[str_detect(names(b), "^Action Unit \\d+ - ") & !str_detect(names(b), " - (Left|Right) - ")]
    if (!length(au_cols)) { au_notes <<- c(au_notes, paste(pid, "– no action unit columns in the export")); return(tibble()) }
    t <- fr_time(b[["Video Time"]])
    valid <- if ("Neutral" %in% names(b)) !is.na(num(b$Neutral)) else !is.na(num(b[[au_cols[1]]]))
    au <- as.data.frame(lapply(b[au_cols], parse_au)); names(au) <- au_cols
    map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(w)), function(i) {
      inb <- !is.na(t) & t >= w$start[i] & t < w$end[i]
      ok  <- inb & valid
      prop <- if (any(inb)) mean(valid[inb]) else 0
      tibble(pid = pid, block = w$block[i], prop_valid = prop, measure = au_cols,
             value = if (prop >= MIN_FACE_VALID) colMeans(au[ok, , drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_)
    })
  })
  if (!nrow(out)) stop("no usable FaceReader detailed logs")
  out |> mutate(au = sprintf("AU%02d", as.integer(str_match(measure, "^Action Unit (\\d+)")[, 2])),
                au_name = str_match(measure, "^Action Unit \\d+ - (.+)$")[, 2],
                measure = paste(au, au_name), block = block_factor(block),
                value = ifelse(is.nan(value), NA, value))
}, "FaceReader action units")
face_valid <- if (nrow(aus)) aus |> distinct(pid, block, prop_valid) else tibble()

# FaceReader heart-rate coverage per block, from the heart beat log: the share of the block
# spanned by consecutive beats no more than MAX_IBI_GAP_S apart. Longer gaps are time with no
# heart-rate signal: face lost, FaceReader's ~8.5-s recalibration after it finds the face again,
# or beats it could not detect. Same block windows as Kubios and the AUs.
hr_cov <- tryCatch({
  wins <- read_fr_windows() |> filter(is_log)
  hb <- list.files(FR_DIR, "heart beat log\\.(txt|xlsx)$", full.names = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
  hb <- hb[!startsWith(basename(hb), "~$")]
  hb <- hb[participant_keep(str_extract(basename(hb), "^[^_]+"), INCLUDE_PILOTS)]
  hb <- hb[!duplicated(norm_pid(str_extract(basename(hb), "^[^_]+")))]
  map_dfr(hb, function(path) {
    pid <- norm_pid(str_extract(basename(path), "^[^_]+"))
    w <- wins |> filter(pid == !!pid, tolower(basename(file)) == tolower(basename(path)))
    if (!nrow(w)) w <- wins |> filter(pid == !!pid) |> filter(file == first(file))
    lg <- read_fr_log(path, "Time")
    if (!nrow(w) || is.null(lg)) return(tibble())
    t <- sort(fr_time(lg$body[[1]])); t <- t[!is.na(t)]
    s <- head(t, -1); e <- t[-1]; ok <- (e - s) <= MAX_IBI_GAP_S
    tibble(pid = pid, block = w$block, prop_hr = map2_dbl(w$start, w$end, function(a, b)
      if (length(t) < 2) 0 else sum(pmax(0, pmin(e, b) - pmax(s, a))[ok]) / (b - a)))
  })
}, error = function(e) tibble())

fr_missing <- full_join(
  if (nrow(face_valid)) face_valid |> transmute(pid, block = as.character(block), face = 100 * (1 - prop_valid)) else tibble(pid = character(), block = character(), face = numeric()),
  if (nrow(hr_cov)) hr_cov |> transmute(pid, block = BLOCK_LABELS[match(block, BLOCKS)], hr = 100 * (1 - pmin(prop_hr, 1))) else tibble(pid = character(), block = character(), hr = numeric()),
  by = c("pid", "block")) |>
  full_join(kubios_qc |> filter(stream == "facereader") |>
              transmute(pid, block = BLOCK_LABELS[match(block, BLOCKS)], kub = corrected), by = c("pid", "block")) |>
  filter(!is.na(block)) |> mutate(block = factor(block, levels = BLOCK_LABELS))
ecg_corrected <- kubios_qc |> filter(stream == "ecg", pid %in% fr_missing$pid) |> pull(corrected)
```

```{r ids}
# One anonymous code per participant, used in every table below
all_pids <- sort(unique(c(ratings$pid, scr$pid, ecg_hr$pid, fr_hr$pid, aus$pid, fr_missing$pid)))
pid_code <- if (ANONYMISE_IDS) setNames(sprintf("P%02d", seq_along(all_pids)), all_pids) else setNames(all_pids, all_pids)
```

## Summary

```{r summary-counts, echo = FALSE}
n_of <- function(d) if (nrow(d)) n_distinct(d$pid[!is.na(d$value)]) else 0
```

Main-study participants`r if (INCLUDE_PILOTS) " and pilots" else ""` with data so far:
self-report **`r n_of(ratings)`**, SCR **`r n_of(scr)`**, ECG HR/HRV **`r n_of(ecg_hr)`**,
FaceReader HR/HRV **`r n_of(fr_hr)`**, FaceReader action units **`r n_of(aus)`**.
The sample is still small, so every test below is **descriptive and exploratory**: it shows
where the data are heading, not confirmed effects.

**How the tests work.** For each measure we fit a linear mixed model
`value ~ block + (1 | participant)`. The *block effect* is the omnibus F test across the five
blocks. The three planned contrasts are estimated differences in the measure's own units
(`*` = p < .05, uncorrected): negative induction vs baseline, positive induction vs baseline,
and positive vs negative induction.

```{r summary-table, results = "asis"}
key_au <- if (nrow(aus)) aus |> filter(au %in% c("AU04", "AU12")) |> mutate(measure = paste("FaceReader", measure)) else aus
all_main <- bind_rows(
  ratings |> mutate(measure = paste("Self-report", tolower(measure)), domain = "1"),
  scr     |> mutate(domain = "2"),
  ecg_hr  |> mutate(measure = paste("ECG", measure), domain = "3"),
  fr_hr   |> mutate(measure = paste("FaceReader", measure), domain = "4"),
  key_au  |> select(pid, block, measure, value) |> mutate(domain = "5"))
if (nrow(all_main)) {
  ord <- all_main |> distinct(domain, measure) |> arrange(domain)
  tt  <- test_table(all_main |> select(-domain))
  pretty_tests(tt) |>
    left_join(block_means(all_main), by = c(Measure = "measure")) |>
    arrange(match(Measure, ord$measure)) |>
    select(Measure, N, all_of(intersect(BLOCK_LABELS, names(block_means(all_main)))), everything()) |>
    kable(caption = "Block means (SD) and block tests. AU rows: the two most-studied AUs (all AUs in section 2.5).",
          align = "l")
} else cat("No data available yet.\n")
```

```{r summary-agreement-short, echo = FALSE}
ag_short <- NULL
if (nrow(ecg_hr) && nrow(fr_hr)) {
  j <- inner_join(ecg_hr, fr_hr, by = c("pid", "block", "measure"), suffix = c("_ecg", "_fr")) |>
    filter(!is.na(value_ecg), !is.na(value_fr))
  if (nrow(j)) ag_short <- j |> group_by(measure) |>
    summarise(bias = mean(value_fr - value_ecg), mae = mean(abs(value_fr - value_ecg)),
              r = if (n() >= 3) cor(value_ecg, value_fr) else NA_real_, .groups = "drop")
}
```

`r rng_txt <- function(x) sprintf("%.0f%% (range %.0f–%.0f%%)", mean(x), min(x), max(x)); if (nrow(fr_missing)) paste0("**FaceReader missing data (section 1.1):** across ", n_distinct(fr_missing$pid), " participants' blocks, ", paste(c(if (any(!is.na(fr_missing$face))) paste("face not found in", rng_txt(na.omit(fr_missing$face)), "of video frames"), if (any(!is.na(fr_missing$hr))) paste("no heart-rate signal for", rng_txt(na.omit(fr_missing$hr)), "of block time"), if (any(!is.na(fr_missing$kub))) paste0("Kubios corrected ", rng_txt(na.omit(fr_missing$kub)), " of FaceReader beats as noise (ECG: ", if (any(!is.na(ecg_corrected))) sprintf("%.1f%%", mean(ecg_corrected, na.rm = TRUE)) else "n/a", ")")), collapse = "; "), ".") else ""`

`r if (!is.null(ag_short)) paste0("**FaceReader vs ECG (section 3):** ", paste(sprintf("%s mean difference %+.1f, mean absolute difference %.1f%s", ag_short$measure, ag_short$bias, ag_short$mae, ifelse(is.na(ag_short$r), "", sprintf(", r = %.2f", ag_short$r))), collapse = "; "), ".") else "**FaceReader vs ECG:** no participants with both Kubios results yet."`

### 1.1 How much FaceReader data is missing

FaceReader data can be missing for two reasons:

1. **The face isn't found.** Shown as the percentage of video frames with no face (no
   expressions or action units for those frames), and the resulting percentage of block time
   with **no heart-rate signal**: gaps of more than `r MAX_IBI_GAP_S` s between detected beats,
   which includes FaceReader's ~8.5-s recalibration each time it finds the face again.
2. **Kubios finds the beat-to-beat (RR) data too noisy.** Shown as the percentage of
   FaceReader's beats that Kubios corrected as artefacts, with the ECG's for comparison. Blocks
   with more than `r FLAG_CORRECTED_PCT`% of beats corrected are counted as noisy.

Kubios artefact (noise) correction was set to **`r KUBIOS_CORRECTION`** for both the ECG and the
FaceReader data. Participants without a FaceReader export aren't included here (see the table
above). Blocks are dropped from the analyses when a face is found in fewer than
`r 100 * MIN_FACE_VALID`% of frames (action units) or Kubios has fewer than `r MIN_BLOCK_BEATS`
beats (HR/HRV).

```{r fr-missing, results = "asis", fig.height = 3.4}
if (!nrow(fr_missing)) {
  cat("> **Not shown:** needs FaceReader detailed logs or heart beat logs plus facereader/Kubios_Samples.csv, or Kubios results for the FaceReader beats.\n")
} else {
  rng <- function(x) { x <- x[!is.na(x)]; if (!length(x)) "–" else sprintf("%.1f (%.1f–%.1f)", mean(x), min(x), max(x)) }
  noisy <- function(x) { x <- x[!is.na(x)]; if (!length(x)) "–" else sprintf("%d / %d", sum(x > FLAG_CORRECTED_PCT), length(x)) }
  ecg_by_block <- kubios_qc |> filter(stream == "ecg", pid %in% fr_missing$pid) |>
    mutate(Block = BLOCK_LABELS[match(block, BLOCKS)])
  ecg_rng <- function(b) rng(if (b == "All blocks") ecg_by_block$corrected else ecg_by_block$corrected[ecg_by_block$Block == b])
  tab <- bind_rows(fr_missing |> group_by(Block = as.character(block)),
                   fr_missing |> mutate(Block = "All blocks") |> group_by(Block)) |>
    summarise(Participants = n_distinct(pid),
              `Face not found: % of frames` = rng(face),
              `No heart-rate signal: % of block time` = rng(hr),
              `Kubios: % of beats corrected` = rng(kub),
              `Noisy blocks` = noisy(kub), .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(`ECG: % of beats corrected` = map_chr(Block, ecg_rng)) |>
    arrange(match(Block, c(BLOCK_LABELS, "All blocks")))
  print(kable(tab, align = "lcccccc", caption = paste0(
    "FaceReader missing data per block: mean across participants (min–max). Noisy blocks = blocks with more than ",
    FLAG_CORRECTED_PCT, "% of beats corrected by Kubios / blocks with Kubios results.")))

  long <- fr_missing |> pivot_longer(c(face, hr, kub), names_to = "what", values_to = "pct") |>
    filter(!is.na(pct)) |>
    mutate(what = factor(recode(what, face = "1. Face not found (% of frames)", hr = "1. No heart-rate signal (% of time)",
                                kub = "2. Kubios: beats corrected (%)")),
           Participant = factor(pid_code[pid], levels = rev(sort(unique(pid_code[pid])))))
  print(ggplot(long, aes(block, Participant, fill = pct)) +
    geom_tile(colour = "white") + geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.0f", pct)), size = 3) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "#F4F4F4", high = "#D9653B", limits = c(0, 100), name = "%") +
    facet_wrap(~ what) + labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) + theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1), panel.grid = element_blank()))
}
```

## 2. Differences between blocks

Thin grey lines are individual participants; filled points are block means ± 1 SE.
Blocks are always plotted in the same order; the order participants did them in is
counterbalanced (negative or positive block first).
`r if (!is.null(order_counts) && nrow(order_counts)) paste0("So far: ", paste0(order_counts$n, " × ", order_counts$conditionOrder, collapse = ", "), if (nrow(order_counts) == 1) ". With only one order so far, block effects are still confounded with time in the session." else ".") else ""`

### 2.5 FaceReader action units

Mean AU intensity (0–1) per block. The heat map shows the change from each participant's own
baseline, averaged across participants; the table tests every AU, with p-values also corrected
for the number of AUs (Benjamini–Hochberg FDR).

```{r au-out, results = "asis", fig.height = 6}
show_note(aus)
if (nrow(aus)) {
  delta <- aus |> filter(!is.na(value)) |> group_by(pid, measure) |>
    mutate(d = value - value[block == "Baseline"][1]) |> ungroup() |>
    filter(block != "Baseline", !is.na(d)) |>
    group_by(measure, block) |> summarise(d = mean(d), .groups = "drop")
  lim <- max(abs(delta$d), 1e-6)
  print(ggplot(delta, aes(block, measure, fill = d)) + geom_tile(colour = "white") +
    geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%+.02f", d)), size = 2.8) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#3F7FB5", mid = "white", high = "#D9653B", limits = c(-lim, lim),
                         name = "Δ vs\nbaseline") +
    scale_y_discrete(limits = rev) + labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) + theme_minimal(base_size = 10))
}
```

```{r au-key, results = "asis", fig.height = 3.6}
  if (nrow(k)) print(plot_blocks(k, ncol = 4, ylab = "Mean intensity (0–1)"))
  print(kable(pretty_tests(test_table(aus |> select(pid, block, measure, value), fdr = TRUE)),
              caption = "All AUs. Contrast estimates are in intensity units (0–1)."))
```

## 3. Do FaceReader and ECG agree?

Both sources were run through Kubios with the same five block windows (FaceReader's on its own
video clock) and the same artefact (noise) correction level (`r KUBIOS_CORRECTION`), so these are the numbers each pipeline delivers as used. Each point is one
participant × block.

```{r agreement, results = "asis"}
if (!nrow(ecg_hr) || !nrow(fr_hr)) {
  cat("> **Not shown:** needs Kubios results for both the ECG and the FaceReader beats.\n")
} else {
  j <- inner_join(ecg_hr, fr_hr, by = c("pid", "block", "measure"), suffix = c("_ecg", "_fr")) |>
    filter(!is.na(value_ecg), !is.na(value_fr)) |> mutate(diff = value_fr - value_ecg, avg = (value_fr + value_ecg) / 2)
  if (!nrow(j)) { cat("> No participant × block has both an ECG and a FaceReader value yet.\n") } else {
    ccc <- function(x, y) 2 * cov(x, y) / (var(x) + var(y) + (mean(x) - mean(y))^2)
    ag <- j |> group_by(measure) |> summarise(
      `Blocks (participants)` = sprintf("%d (%d)", n(), n_distinct(pid)),
      `ECG mean` = mean(value_ecg), `FaceReader mean` = mean(value_fr),
      `Bias (FR − ECG)` = mean(diff),
      `95% limits of agreement` = sprintf("%.1f to %.1f", mean(diff) - 1.96 * sd(diff), mean(diff) + 1.96 * sd(diff)),
      `Mean abs. difference` = mean(abs(diff)),
      `Mean abs. % difference` = 100 * mean(abs(diff) / value_ecg),
      r = if (n() >= 3) cor(value_ecg, value_fr) else NA_real_,
      CCC = if (n() >= 3) ccc(value_ecg, value_fr) else NA_real_, .groups = "drop") |>
      rename(Measure = measure)
    print(kable(ag, digits = 2, caption = "Agreement per measure. CCC = Lin's concordance (1 = identical values)."))

    print(ggplot(j, aes(value_ecg, value_fr)) +
      geom_abline(linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
      geom_point(aes(fill = block), shape = 21, size = 2.6, colour = "grey20") +
      scale_fill_manual(values = BLOCK_COLS, name = NULL) +
      facet_wrap(~ measure, scales = "free") +
      labs(x = "ECG (Kubios)", y = "FaceReader (Kubios)", title = "FaceReader vs ECG (dashed line = perfect agreement)") +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 11) + theme(legend.position = "bottom"))

    loa <- j |> group_by(measure) |> summarise(b = mean(diff), lo = b - 1.96 * sd(diff), hi = b + 1.96 * sd(diff))
    print(ggplot(j, aes(avg, diff)) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey75") +
      geom_hline(data = loa, aes(yintercept = b), colour = "grey20") +
      geom_hline(data = loa, aes(yintercept = lo), linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
      geom_hline(data = loa, aes(yintercept = hi), linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
      geom_point(aes(fill = block), shape = 21, size = 2.6, colour = "grey20") +
      scale_fill_manual(values = BLOCK_COLS, name = NULL) +
      facet_wrap(~ measure, scales = "free") +
      labs(x = "Mean of ECG and FaceReader", y = "FaceReader − ECG",
           title = "Bland–Altman (solid = bias, dashed = 95% limits of agreement)") +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 11) + theme(legend.position = "bottom"))

    # Does FaceReader show the same block pattern as the ECG? Within-participant changes from baseline
    dj <- j |> group_by(pid, measure) |>
      mutate(d_ecg = value_ecg - value_ecg[block == "Baseline"][1], d_fr = value_fr - value_fr[block == "Baseline"][1]) |>
      ungroup() |> filter(block != "Baseline", !is.na(d_ecg), !is.na(d_fr))
    if (nrow(dj) >= 3) {
      cat("\n\nChange from baseline: do the two sources move together within a participant?\n\n")
      print(kable(dj |> group_by(Measure = measure) |>
        summarise(`Blocks` = n(), `r (change vs baseline)` = if (n() >= 3) cor(d_ecg, d_fr) else NA_real_,
                  `Same direction (%)` = 100 * mean(sign(d_ecg) == sign(d_fr)), .groups = "drop"), digits = 2))
    }
  }
}
```

The limits of agreement treat every block as independent, although each participant
contributes up to five; with more participants this should become a repeated-measures
Bland–Altman analysis.

## Notes

- **Block-level ratings** are the state ratings given at the end of each block (baseline: after the
  3-minute fixation), not the ratings of the individual videos.
- **SCR** is Ledalab continuous decomposition over 0–180 s from each block onset.
- **HR/HRV**: Kubios HRV Scientific on the BIOPAC ECG and, separately, on FaceReader's heart
  beat log (1:1 lossless video of the webcam), with artefact (noise) correction set to
  `r KUBIOS_CORRECTION` for both. FaceReader blocks with fewer than
  `r MIN_BLOCK_BEATS` beats are dropped.
- **Action units** are FaceReader intensities averaged over frames with a detected face, in the
  same windows as FaceReader HR/HRV. Blocks with a face in fewer than `r 100 * MIN_FACE_VALID`%
  of frames are dropped.
- Participants: main-study only`r if (INCLUDE_PILOTS) " plus pilots" else ""`; pilot, test and
  excluded sessions are set in `participant_status.csv`.
